prompts.prompt: A stunning Asian woman in a vibrant red chiffon gala dress with sweetheart corset bodice and off-shoulder puffed sleeves, seated gracefully on a rustic weathered wooden bridge over a calm stream. Lush bougainvillea flowers in pink and magenta cascade around her, creating a romantic canopy. Golden hour sunlight filters through the foliage, casting warm honeyed light on her skin. Shot with 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh. Her long black hair flows softly in a gentle breeze. Cinematic color grading, 3:4 aspect ratio, ultra high resolution, photorealistic.
